title: Mark the device's own time zone in the location list
body:
With several locations in the list, it is not obvious which row matches the user's
  current time zone. Mark that row so the user sees it at a glance.

  - A row whose IANA time zone matches the device's time zone shows a "Your time zone"
    badge next to the city name.
  - If no row matches, no badge is shown. If several rows match, each of them gets the
    badge.
  - The device zone is read once at startup through the existing time abstraction
    (@/lib/temporal), never from raw UTC offsets.
  - Screen readers announce the badge as part of the row's name.
  - The badge text is localized in en and ru.
  - Unit tests cover the match, no-match and multiple-match cases with a fake clock zone.
    The visual regression baselines are updated for the badge.

  Out of scope: choosing a reference zone, reordering rows, detecting zone changes while
  the app is open.
